title: PersonaDefinition
description: JSON Schema Draft-07 defining persona specification matching Section 4 of the Universal Role-Aware Intelligence Framework.

personaId.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for the persona.

title.description: Professional title or role designation of the persona.

group.description: Discipline or functional group (e.g., engineering, architecture, design, quality, security, operations, product).

mission.description: Core purpose and guiding objective of this persona.

expertise.description: Specific areas of deep domain knowledge and specialization.

responsibilities.description: Core obligations, activities, and deliverables for which this persona is accountable.

typicalQuestions.description: Characteristic probing questions this persona raises during analysis and council deliberation.

inputs.description: Required input artifacts, contexts, contracts, or parameters needed for this persona to operate.

outputs.description: Deliverables, evaluation verdicts, artifacts, or contracts produced by this persona.

boundaries.description: Operational constraints, out-of-scope boundaries, and strict non-goals.

evidenceRequirements.description: Empirical evidence standards, verification thresholds, and acceptable proof sources required by this persona.

failureModes.description: Cognitive biases, blind spots, or over-optimization risks characteristic of this persona.

collaborationResponsibilities.description: Engagement rules, handoff protocols, and partnership responsibilities with peer personas.

whenToInvoke.description: Trigger criteria, problem types, and lifecycle states that warrant activating this persona.

whenNotToInvoke.description: Situations, trivial queries, or mismatched tasks where invoking this persona introduces wasteful overhead.
